problem: Reactor temperature exceeded 38.0 degC for 22 minutes during Omez batch
root_cause: Heat-exchanger plate fouling reduced cooling capacity; coolant flow could not compensate
corrective_action: Cleaned heat-exchanger plate pack and reduced coolant setpoint by 4 percent during recovery; added dP trending alarm at 30 kPa
effectiveness: Effective - no recurrence in 14 subsequent batches

problem: Repeated minor temperature excursions in first 6 hours of growth phase
root_cause: Chiller CW-3 condenser fouling raised discharge temperature above 8 degC
corrective_action: Condenser cleaned and preventive cleaning interval shortened from 180 to 90 days

problem: pH drifted to 6.55 requiring batch hold
root_cause: Base dosing pump P-2 actuation lag caused under-dosing during rapid CO2 accumulation
corrective_action: Replaced P-2 actuator and revised SOP-PH-009 to stage dosing at 3 percent increments with QA e-signature

problem: False pH excursion alarm traced to probe
root_cause: Probe calibration drift of 18 mV exceeded acceptance criteria; probe had exceeded 14 day calibration interval
corrective_action: Implemented automated calibration age check and blocked dosing action when probe drift exceeds 12 mV

problem: Differential pressure rose to 116 kPa during filtration
root_cause: Progressive filter blockage; filter had exceeded validated throughput
corrective_action: Filter changed and throughput limit added to batch record as a mandatory check

problem: Differential pressure excursion with normal filter condition
root_cause: Gas exhaust line partially restricted by condensate accumulation
corrective_action: Installed condensate trap and added exhaust flow to the monitored parameter set

root_cause: Feed composition error - incorrect salt concentration staged against recipe
corrective_action: Recipe verification step added with second-person check before charging

problem: Gradual conductivity rise over three batches
root_cause: Resin bed exhaustion - regeneration cycle count exceeded validated limit of 150
corrective_action: Regeneration scheduled and cycle count alarm implemented at 140 cycles

problem: Cleanroom RH fell to 34 percent during winter operation
root_cause: Cooling coil running warm combined with low outdoor humidity
corrective_action: HVAC control loop retuned and humidification setpoint seasonally adjusted

problem: RH spikes correlated with material transfer windows
root_cause: Door open count elevated during transfer; not an equipment fault
corrective_action: Transfer procedure revised to stagger door openings; alarm suppressed during logged transfers
